business_problem: Serre Chevalier needed a smarter way to answer multilingual, context-dependent visitor questions about ski-pass selection and trip planning because its earlier assistant could not keep pace with growing resort complexity and seasonal support demand.
solution_summary: Serre Chevalier worked with IBM, Next Decision, and IBM Client Engineering to replace its older digital assistant with an agentic support experience built on IBM watsonx Orchestrate and IBM Cloud. The system is structured as cooperating agents that interpret visitor intent, retrieve the most relevant resort knowledge, and invoke supporting tools such as Python-based utilities to answer questions about ski passes, trip planning, and operational details in real time. As the deployment matured, the resort added IBM watsonx.governance for monitoring and visibility and IBM watsonx.ai for recurring data-gathering work such as daily web scraping that feeds operational workflows. Because the AI is embedded directly into the website, visitors get guided help without changing channels, while service teams spend less time on routine inquiries and can focus on the more complex issues that still require human intervention. The same orchestration model is now expanding into snow operations, HR workflows, and predictive equipment dashboards.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Coordinates the resort’s agentic AI workflows for visitor support and emerging operational use cases.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the visitor-facing AI experience so it can scale during busy planning and travel periods.

solution_components.name: IBM Client Engineering
solution_components.role: Helped align objectives, workflows, and data inputs so the agentic experience could be launched quickly.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.governance
solution_components.role: Improves visibility and monitoring across the resort’s multi-LLM setup and operations dashboards.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Automates recurring data-gathering tasks such as daily web scraping that feed operational workflows.

data_flow: Visitor questions arrive through the Serre Chevalier website, watsonx Orchestrate routes them to agents that retrieve resort knowledge and process live inputs, responses are returned in near real time, and supporting watsonx.ai automation and governance feed the operational dashboards and future expansion areas such as snow monitoring and equipment management.
business_outcome: The new AI agent reduced response latency, improved complaint resolution, handled large volumes of visitor conversations, and created a platform the resort can extend into operational workflows beyond customer care.
